playoff.note: Conference League play-off, separate from the title: 8th-11th play a single-match preliminary round, 2nd-7th enter at the quarter-finals, quarter-finals and semi-finals are two-legged, and the 2nd-3rd and 4th-5th placing finals are single matches. The champion (table) takes the Champions League place.

conflicts.topic: Who takes the second European place
conflicts.detail: The Italian league article says the 2nd-placed club qualifies for the Conference League; the English 2025-26 season article says the winner of the 2-11 play-off qualifies. The play-off exists either way; only its prize differs.

conflicts.topic: San Marino Academy U22 is not an ordinary club
conflicts.detail: One of the 16 participants is the federation's U22 academy side. It is a full member of the table and can finish anywhere, including 1st, but it is not a normal club that could be promoted or relegated.

notes: Single level, no lower division, so closed in both directions and no boundaries. 16 clubs = 15 ordinary clubs + San Marino Academy U22. Title decided by the 30-round table since 2023-24; the 2nd-11th play-off only allocates the second Conference League place. Season started 28 August 2026. Clubs have no home grounds - venues are drawn per match. There is no English Wikipedia page for 2026-27; the Italian page is the primary source.
